The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Tsheyk]] owned a '''game preserve''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and reconnaissance scans of the preserve found that the predators in the preserve were forming a unique ecosystem.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Biology|Master of None}}</ref>
